episodes.title: Balhae Lunar Research Station
episodes.summary: Director Choi's briefing about the mission leaves Song Jian displeased. Reaching the research station alone proves no easy feat for the crew.

episodes.title: Three Storages
episodes.summary: The crew's initial findings are at odds with their knowledge of the research station. Split into threes, the members set out to look for the sample.

episodes.title: Cause of Death
episodes.summary: Jian's body cam captures a startling moment of life and death. Submerged in sweat, Gong Soochan shows worrisome signs of an unusual infection.

episodes.title: The Truth Comes Out
episodes.summary: Han Yunjae updates the director and gets access to a restricted area. The crew learns of the sample's powers and the true motive behind their mission.

episodes.title: Secret Storage
episodes.summary: Recalling her sister's encrypted message, Jian searches the database for Luna. A young intruder and a double-crosser emerge from the shadows.

episodes.title: Key to Salvation
episodes.summary: E2, Ryu Taesuk and the samples go missing. Seeing a familiar name on the intruder, Jian follows her down the vents for answers.

episodes.title: Luna
episodes.summary: Jian opens a hard drive that chronicles Song Wonkyung's life and work on the station. Meanwhile, others uncover the remains of the experiment.

episodes.title: The Silent Sea
episodes.summary: Racing against time as the research station falls under destruction, the surviving crew members decide on the fate of the mission — and their own.
